description: On migrated PostgreSQL, race initial setup for two clients on a zero-seat sponsor, retry the winning setup after failed email delivery, replace its pending invitation and accept it. Only the current assignment can activate. A second sponsor can run its own pilot.

Use ordinary technician setup and sign-in with a one-user base trial. Invitation acceptance and unsuccessful login leave the deadline empty. Two successful session starts yield one 360-hour window, also across a DST change. Check the dates shown and the later-start path for an existing subscriber.

With a live session exercise scoped ticket reads and writes immediately before and at expiry. Repeat at earlier base-trial lapse and after base reactivation. Verify MSP-visible history, client isolation, retained principal class and refusal of a second pilot after termination.

With existing paid Seat and Workspace allocations and a pilot, exercise pool reservation, resize and lapse. Convert with spare capacity concurrently with another reservation. Paid capacity stays consistent and no checkout occurs for a spare seat.

Exercise Stripe-emulated conversion at zero spare capacity, payment decline, stale quotes and checkout return before verification. Replay paid webhook after pilot expiry and worker restart. Verify one quantity increase, one paid assignment and the same ticket authorship.

Through the normal overview, direct page and server actions exercise an account-only purchaser, client-scoped operator, authorized sponsor admin, CE, appliance and closed rollout. Stop intake during an active pilot and verify expiry and paid recovery still operate.

Record technician and MSP work in both orders. Ignore views and separate tickets. Replayed events, repeat comments and webhook retries yield one event per milestone. A pilot that never activates yields none.
